# ctables/if

> Conditional: `if`, `elif`, `else`, with `goto`.

truck [ctables](../ctables.md) · [source](../../../registry/ctables/if.pkg) · translates [std/if](../std/if.md)

  Each condition jumps past its block when false, like bintables, so the
  labels and the order of evaluation are the same.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
if (!(
{cond}
)) goto {L.next};
{then}
goto {L.end};
{L.next}:;
{each elif}
if (!(
{it.cond}
)) goto {it.L.next};
{it.then}
goto {L.end};
{it.L.next}:;
{end}
{else}
{L.end}:;
```
